disclaimer: This profile evaluates common service-handling behaviours. It does not claim domain-specific regulatory or organizational compliance.

policy_sources.title: General service evaluation baseline
policy_sources.notes: Defines common request, process, interaction, and outcome behaviours used when no domain-specific profile is available.

intents.title: General customer-service request
intents.description: The customer contacts an organization for information, assistance, or completion of a service request.
selection_guidance: Use when a more specific validated domain profile is not available.

requirements.title: Request understood
requirements.business_definition: The agent demonstrates an accurate understanding of what the customer is asking for before moving into the solution.
evidence_expectations: The agent restates, confirms, or responds specifically to the customer's request.

requirements.title: Process explained accurately
requirements.business_definition: The agent gives a clear and internally consistent explanation of the process, information, or action relevant to the request.
evidence_expectations: The agent explains the relevant process or information without a material contradiction.
Any customer action needed to continue is stated clearly.

requirements.title: Agent identified the service context
requirements.business_definition: The opening makes it clear that the customer has reached an agent representing the relevant organization or service.
evidence_expectations: The agent identifies themselves, the organization, or the service context near the beginning of the call.

requirements.title: Customer concerns addressed
requirements.business_definition: The agent acknowledges and responds to material questions, constraints, or concerns raised by the customer.
evidence_expectations: Material customer concerns receive a relevant response rather than being ignored or dismissed.

requirements.title: Outcome and next steps clear
requirements.business_definition: The close of the call makes clear what was resolved, what remains open, and what happens next.
evidence_expectations: The agent states the outcome or current status of the request.
Any remaining next step, owner, or timeframe is explained when applicable.
